plugins.name: director-kit
plugins.description: Direct AI video like a real director — turn a plain idea or a written story into a continuity-locked, character-consistent short (story, ad, reel, or trailer). Pipeline: brief -> assets -> shot list + continuity ledger -> storyboard -> animate. Auto-generates via the fal connector where available (Claude Code); otherwise produces ready-to-paste prompts.

plugins.name: edit-kit
plugins.description: Post-production for talking-head video. Non-destructive cleanup steps from raw footage to a reviewable cut. Requires the private superwebpros/compound-remotion repo for the Remotion/Lambda render.
